kinds.doc: The last close is above a level.

params.doc: price level in the instrument's currency
params.name: level

kinds.doc: The last close is below a level.

params.doc: price level in the instrument's currency
params.name: level

kinds.doc: The close moved by at least threshold over window_days sessions.

params.doc: trading sessions (daily bars), including the last one
params.name: window_days

params.doc: size of the move as a fraction (0.1 = 10%)
params.name: threshold

params.doc: up, down or any
params.name: direction

kinds.doc: The last close is at least threshold below the highest close of the window.

params.doc: trading sessions (daily bars), including the last one
params.name: window_days

params.doc: drop from the high (0.15 = 15%)
params.name: threshold

kinds.doc: The last close is above every other close of the window.

params.doc: trading sessions (daily bars), including the last one
params.name: window_days

kinds.doc: The last close is above (or below) the simple moving average of the window: the signal opens on the cross and resolves when the price crosses back.

params.doc: trading sessions (daily bars), including the last one
params.name: window_days

params.doc: above or below
params.name: direction

kinds.doc: The instrument's (or bucket's) share of the portfolio is above threshold.

params.doc: weight as a fraction (0.3 = 30%)
params.name: threshold

params.doc: strategy bucket id (scope bucket only)
params.name: bucket

kinds.doc: The instrument's (or bucket's) share of the portfolio is below threshold (an instrument that is not held weighs 0).

params.doc: weight as a fraction (0.3 = 30%)
params.name: threshold

params.doc: strategy bucket id (scope bucket only)
params.name: bucket

kinds.doc: A condition in the strategy expression language (EXPRESSIONS.md), evaluated for the instrument (held positions only), a bucket or the portfolio.

params.doc: e.g. "weight > 10%" or "cash_weight >= 5%"
params.name: expression

params.doc: strategy bucket id (scope bucket only)
params.name: bucket

kinds.doc: The last close leaves the min / max close of the previous window_days sessions while that range ((max - min) / min) was at most max_range_pct: a break out of a consolidation. A one-session event (the next window contains the break).

params.doc: sessions before the last one that form the range
params.name: window_days

params.doc: widest range that counts as a consolidation, a fraction (0.08 = 8%)
params.name: max_range_pct

params.doc: up, down or any
params.name: direction

kinds.doc: The last session's volume is at least multiple times the average volume of the previous window_days sessions.

params.doc: sessions before the last one that form the average
params.name: window_days

params.doc: volume as a multiple of the average (2.5 = 2.5x)
params.name: multiple
